quest.title: Boong Boong Bwoooom! A Grand Plot!
quest.description: The appointed time has arrived. You move to investigate the illegal black market...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Legion Morale x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

chapter.title: Boong Boong Bwoooom! A Grand Plot!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Ah, if it isn't the owner of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop! What an honor! How can I assist you?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let me do the talking... It's simple. We just want to know if anyone has tried to sell one of the Craftshop's bots around here recently.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Ah, well... I won't lie to you. We're very much a "need-to-know" establishment — meaning we don't make a habit of asking for details about the transactions that take place here. It's one of the advantages of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Our clients are free to buy or sell whatsoever they might wish. All they need to do is post a notice on the bulletin board.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's it? No wonder this place is illegal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you guys! The first notice here is offering a huge sum of Mora in exchange for Aino's newest robot!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Krum-Clank was stolen! And you just sit back and let people peddle stolen goods for cash? That makes you just as bad as the thief!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: I'm afraid it's not that simple. As I said, we never question the terms of our transactions.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: It's a matter of professionalism. Remaining neutral in client disputes is a must.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Krum-Clank is more than a robot. He's my friend! I'm not gonna let him be sold off like some second-rate piece of scrap!

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! You can't tear that down! I'm obligated to keep it up until closing at least. Please, show some understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened to "remaining neutral in client disputes"...

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Listen, customers have to pay to put up a notice, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: We have to turn a profit somehow. If you pay more than the original customer, I'll let you cover that notice up with one of your own.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Enough. This place clearly has its rules. There's no point in making a scene. Besides, we found a clue, didn't we? Let's see what the notice says.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh... "Willing to part with large sum in return for specific robot. It appears to be the work of the Krumkake Craftshop. Details negotiable in person..."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "According to intel from an informant, there is only one of its kind in existence. It is currently in the hands of the Frostmoon Scions..."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "Present the robot to me, and a generous sum of Mora will be yours..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Frostmoon Scions? Does that mean...?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: The Krumkake Craftshop is situated between the Frostmoon Enclave and Nasha Town. Their people always pass by the workshop whenever they need to head into town.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Over time, you get used to it. Ineffa and I never even thought to be on guard...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, does that mean the Frostmoon Scions stole your bot? But, why?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...I know why! They obviously want Krum-Clank's desserts for themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Desserts?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah, Ineffa is always controlling my "sugar intake" or whatever, so that's why I created Krum-Clank. All you gotta do is input the recipe and provide the ingredients, and he bakes desserts for you!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: All this... for a dessert-baking robot?
Haha, trying to downplay it, are we, Miss Aino? Not convincing enough to fool the various factions of Nod-Krai, I'm afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Asikko? Oh, uh, my boss knows him. He's quite a respected guy in that circle... What are you doing in a place like this?

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: The Voynich Guild isn't the only place to make deals, you know. Business often requires one to... expand their horizons.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: And when it comes to lucrative opportunities, I'm not one to discriminate. In fact, I'm the one who got someone to post the notice you just saw.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So you're the one who's trying to buy Krum-Clank! You're as rotten as the rest of 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: Now, now. It's just business.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: I have a... fascination with this robot of yours, Miss Aino. I tried to purchase it from the Frostmoon Scions, but those zealots wouldn't budge.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: So, here I am, right at the source. I want you to fashion another of its kind. Mora is no object. I'll even offer you ten times the number on the notice.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I don't do business with rotten thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Your notice didn't talk about how you want this done. In other words, stealing is fair game...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You're telling me someone of your esteem is willing to risk your reputation for a cake-baking robot?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: How about this? Share the intel from your informant, and the Krumkake Craftshop will owe you a favor...

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: According to my intel, this bot is capable of much more than baking cakes. It incorporates the technology of the "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon" and has formidable potential as a weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: Look at that cannon. It's capable of condensing kuuvahki into highly destructive energy. But, it's too big and cumbersome to be mass-produced and transported.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: Not to mention, it takes a considerable amount of time between firings to prepare the ammunition... All in all, it's not something that can be commercialized.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: But, if you make it smaller and easier to mass-produce, you have the perfect product, even if it doesn't quite replicate the power of that cannon.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: Besides, if you think about it, is that not precisely why the Frostmoon Scions targeted your bot in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: In their doctrine, kuuvahki is a sacred power. They'd consider it blasphemy to treat it as anything but.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: The giant cannon in Nasha Town uses kuuvahki to fend off the Wild Hunt and protect the people, which is something the Frostmoon Scions can accept.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: But turning that technology into a product, and allowing anyone with Mora to purchase it via the black market and wield the power of kuuvahki for themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: Now, that is blasphemy of the highest order, I would imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: A lot of trouble could come knocking at your doorstep, Miss Aino. But sell that technology to me, and it all goes away. Easy as that.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Please don't tell me you've made some kind of war machine again?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Krum-Clank isn't a war machine! I already told you, he makes desserts — and deliciously scrumptiously yummy ones, at that!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: He's my friend, and I'm gonna get him back no matter what it takes! So you can take your offer and get lost!

dialogues.speaker: Asikko
dialogues.text: It appears negotiations have broken down... A real pity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well? What do we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: We know Krum-Clank is with the Frostmoon Scions, so all we have to do is go there, and then... um....

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we ask Lauma for help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hold up. I should warn you, if that merchant was telling the truth, things are about to get tricky. Just be prepared, okay?

talks.objective: Go to the place where you agreed to meet Jahoda

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jahoda! Wow, this place is packed!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Heh, my intel network never steers me wrong. Now, I'm thinking we start off by checking whatever transaction records we can find. See if our thief already made the sale...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: HEY! Which one of you is the rotten thief who stole my robot, huh? Come out, and show yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (That was not what I had in mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Curious Merchant
dialogues.text: My, my. You must be the owner of the Krumkake Craftshop!

dialogues.speaker: Eager Merchant
dialogues.text: Now THIS is an opportunity I've been waiting for. Always easier to talk business in person.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wh—Which one of you is the thief?

dialogues.speaker: Curious Merchant
dialogues.text: No thieves here. Only shrewd businesspeople. Speaking of... You do custom orders, right? Kid, make me a robot — I'll be sure to make it worth your while.

dialogues.speaker: Eager Merchant
dialogues.text: You're the one who built that robo-maid, right? Is it for sale? I'm dying to get my hands on one!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Both of you... get out of my face!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem! It's clear you two have no respect for even the most basic of rules! No wonder an illegal market like this is the only one that'll take you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Even if Miss Aino is willing to do business with you — and that's a big if — all negotiations go through the front desk, understood?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: As you can see, this kid's creations are a hot commodity in Nod-Krai. I'm not surprised these merchants are practically clambering over each other in excitement.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I don't care. Ineffa's not for sale, and neither is Krum-Clank. These grown-ups are getting on my nerves.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #But {NICKNAME} was right... They're not gonna fess up 'cause they don't even feel guilty. There goes my plan...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, getting them to confess was kind of a long shot...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If you figured that would work, you're even more out of touch than I thought. These people only care about one thing — Mora. Being a "good person" doesn't exactly pad the pockets.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If we want information, the front desk is the place to start. Follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us. Hmm... I sense you are troubled. Please, unburden yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You saw right through us again, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Bathed in moonlight, the concern in your features is as stark as the dark spots on a full moon, ever betraying the emotion that lies beneath the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I tell Aino to keep quiet for one second, and of course, she throws a tantrum... Lady Moonchanter, allow me to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Jahoda explains the situation, choosing her words very carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Theft? How despicable. A disgrace on the Frostmoon Scions.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's all just speculation at this point...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A few days ago, a mechanical construct was brought back to the Frostmoon Scions. Come, I will speak to the offenders at once. I am certain the truth of the matter will reveal itself.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us. What can I do for you, my Lady?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lauma explains the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Theft? We would never do such a thing! This is baseless slander!

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: We did recover a dangerous mechanical device, but we didn't steal it. We confiscated it from a group of bandits.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If there's been a misunderstanding, our guests deserve an explanation.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: I remember, it was a few days ago, out in the wild...

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Huh? What's going on over there?

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: It's still not done? C'mon, we need to finish these tests before the locals are onto us!

dialogues.speaker: Rash Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Can't we just go somewhere else? This job is putting me on edge...

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: No, idiot! Didn't you hear what the boss said? This thing uses kuuvahki. Why else would we be out here? Now, shut up, and get moving!

dialogues.speaker: Rash Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Not so loud! I just need to think. This should be it...

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: What did you do? Are you trying to give us away?

dialogues.speaker: Rash Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: No, I... Look, at least we know this thing's powerful, right? We should have enough to report back on!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Alright. Then let's pack up and get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Stop right there! Drop that dangerous device at once!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Shoot, that was quick. Can you activate this thing again?

dialogues.speaker: Rash Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: I don't even remember what I did... Are we supposed to run with this thing? It weighs a ton!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Let's just make a run for it. The most important thing is that we don't get caught!

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: So, that's what happened. We didn't catch the bandits. But, we were able to intercept the device.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aino, I'll ask you one more time. Are you sure you didn't make some kind of war machine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe this is another misunderstanding? We don't know for sure that the device Aatso confiscated is Krum-Clank...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hm... Did it have this symbol on it?

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That's the one I designed for my bots. I made it so that even if the bot gets dismantled or modified, the symbol can't be removed.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, Krum-Clank is definitely the bot you picked up...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Misunderstanding resolved, then. The device will be returned to its rightful owner.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Forgive me, my Lady, but I believe that is far too risky.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Although this device is similar in principle to the cannon in Nasha Town, the two cannot be seen in the same light.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: By harnessing kuuvahki, the cannon has protected this land from the Wild Hunt time and time again. I've always regarded it as a blessing from the Moon Goddess.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: But, this construct... is more like a commercial product. In the hands of those with nefarious intentions, it could easily be exploited for personal gain.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: As far as I'm aware, this young lady often has dealings with the major factions of Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: I suspect she created the device to sell it for profit. If it ends up on the black market, in the hands of those who would misuse our goddess's gifts—

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Krum-Clank is my friend! He's not for sale!

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: ...As much as I would like to believe you, that is a risk we cannot take. It is blasphemous to allow the power of our sacred moonlight to be exploited!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I warned them that things were about to get tricky. What have I gotten myself into...)

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: The best course of action is to destroy this dangerous device and prevent anything like it from ever being created again...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What did you just say? Are you threatening to destroy Krum-Clank?

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: You must understand. The consequences could be dire...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No, you just want Krum-Clank for yourselves, just like everyone else! Get out of my way!

talks.objective: Go deeper into the Frostmoon Scions' encampment

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: P—Please... Calm yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino!

choices.text: This isn't how we solve problems, Aino!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, you heard him! He wants to destroy Krum-Clank...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We won't let that happen! But causing trouble isn't going to help the situation.

response.speaker: Helmi
response.text: N—Not good! A group of flying machines just ambushed the storage facility and took back the device!

response.speaker: Aatso
response.text: What? That can't just be a coincidence... They must've taken advantage of our conflict with this girl...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's a lot of recon bots!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: It must be those black market merchants! I knew we wouldn't get off so easy!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I can create a temporary Moonlane here. Could you get the kuuhenki to help, Traveler?

choices.text: I won't let anything happen to Krum-Clank.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, just trust us! But you have to calm down, Aino. Making a scene isn't gonna solve anything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That last one must have Krum-Clank! Ah, it's getting away!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hey! Get back here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino, watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Darn it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino—

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh... Right. The recon bot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just glad you're okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Phew... That was way too close! Reckless much, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: At least it all turned out okay... Nice fighting back there, by the way. Thought I'd have to swoop in and save the day, but guess I was wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (That really was way too close. If something happens to that kid, I don't know how I'd explain it to Ineffa...)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay? No, it's not okay! How is it okay? Krum-Clank's been stolen... again! *sob* No, stop... You're the boss of the Krumkake Craftshop, Aino. You can't cry at a time like this.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Allow me to apologize on behalf of my people. If we hadn't tried to stop you, perhaps you could have reached your companion in time.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: My Lady...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If she truly viewed that robot as a "product," she could simply create another. But, instead, she demonstrated a degree of courage that should put us all to shame.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Not even the light of the full moon could reveal the slightest blemish in her goodness. But, your hearts... are sinking into shadows that the moonlight cannot reach.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: ...You have my sincerest apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay. It was all just one big misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Do not despair, young one. "The pure of heart will always have the moonlight to guide them."

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm confident that you will retrieve your companion. I can even send some of my people to help if needed.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That brings us to our next question... Where should we go now?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's obvious. That stunt just now? It had that merchant from the black market written all over it. He knew we were walking into a conflict with the Frostmoon Scions, and he used that as his opening.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'd even go so far as to say, he's the one that stole your bot in the first place. Explains how he knew it was here, and could set this all up.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If you want my opinion, Asikko's your biggest suspect. But I guess we can't rule out the other merchants either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... So, that means you know where we should search next!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (So, it's all up to me again? That market is long gone. Who knows where those merchants scurried off to, and we don't even know which one's the real culprit. *sigh*... This is what I get for trying to sound confident.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You just can't stand seeing Aino so upset, right Jahoda? Aww, that's so nice! From here on out, we're counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's all up to you, Jahoda!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (...Great. How am I supposed to back out now!?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Fine. A—At least... give me two days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! See, Aino? Look at all the help you've got — everything's gonna be fine!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I know... Thanks, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Eustachy
dialogues.text: Our paid services are still on the table. Perhaps you could reconsider.

dialogues.speaker: Aatso
dialogues.text: Stop this at once! We cannot let you leave with that dangerous device!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I told you, Krum-Clank is my friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino, calm down!
